source_title: Khazri, Shimmi & Parash (2022), PLOS ONE 17(8):e0273840, S1 Data

dimensions.Stature: Standing vertex height, barefoot, Frankfort plane, inhaled breath
dimensions.HL: Distal wrist crease midpoint to middle fingertip
dimensions.HB: Lateral second to medial fifth metacarpal surface at knuckles
dimensions.HS: Thumb tip to little-finger tip with hand spread wide
dimensions.2ICL: Middle-finger PIP to DIP joint crease distance; not bone length

source_units: cm for every numeric column, verified against article methods
conversion: mm = source cm * 10; covariance mm^2 = covariance cm^2 * 100

methods.quantiles: empirical linear interpolation, pandas/numpy default type7
methods.outlier_flags: within reported stratum per dimension, outside Q1-1.5IQR/Q3+1.5IQR; retained
methods.population_weighting: none; equal sample strata do not imply population weights

publication_checks.resolution: S1 supports methods n368 and approximates Table7; source of remaining discrepancies unknown

limitations: Cross-sectional selected students, ages18-25, not a global/player sample
Actual within-person covariance restricted to recorded external dimensions
No digit/thumb segment lengths, MCP origins, loaded posture, force or guitar outcomes
Span protocol is flat wide thumb-little spread, not simultaneous fretting
Reported paper inconsistencies are not silently corrected
